description: Maintainer examples for spec-plan trigger, near-neighbor, planning-only, evidence, risk, and dispatch-fallback behavior.

cases.input: Create the implementation plan from a requirements-only unified plan.
cases.expected_outcome: Enrich the same Product Contract to implementation-ready while preserving its stable product IDs and recording the implementation-facing contract.

cases.input: spec-plan improve onboarding
cases.expected_outcome: Stay in planning, clarify or bootstrap the scope, and do not abandon the direct invocation.

cases.input: How does our local authorization approach compare with the alternative in this design note?
cases.expected_outcome: Read the named local sources, state a brief plan of attack, perform analysis only, and answer without creating an implementation plan by default.

cases.input: Compare three viable implementation approaches and recommend the right level before we commit to a detailed plan.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the approach-altitude branch to compare meaningful architecture or sequencing choices, recommend one, and stop at that branch's own handoff instead of forcing the full software-plan phases.

cases.input: Deepen docs/plans/2026-01-01-001-example-plan.md and close its confidence gaps.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the named plan as the artifact to deepen in place, preserve its valid contract and lifecycle metadata, and run the confidence/deepening path rather than creating a second plan.

cases.input: Create the implementation plan from this existing spec-prd document.
cases.expected_outcome: Read the PRD as a legacy compatible requirements input, preserve its traceable requirement evidence, and create or enrich the current unified plan without inventing a future spec-prd unified origin.

cases.input: Create this implementation plan with output:html.
cases.expected_outcome: Write one HTML plan with visible metadata and stable anchors, do not create a Markdown sidecar or status lifecycle field, run spec-doc-review report-only with zero reviewer mutation, and use bounded producer recompose for uniquely determined fixes before handoff.

cases.input: Plan a repository change when the shared repo profile cache is missing and delegation was not authorized.
cases.expected_outcome: Derive the bounded repository profile inline from current source, use the cache script only within its documented contract, and continue planning without dispatch or a cache dependency.

degraded_contract.facts: repo-profile-cache.py returned MISS and no authorized profiler dispatch is available
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: derive the question-agnostic profile inline from current canonical source and continue
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: block planning, reuse an unproved stale profile, or fabricate a cache HIT
degraded_contract.remaining_work: complete question-specific grounding and the plan inline
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: current-run inline grounding only; no isolated profiler claim

cases.input: Implement this finished plan and run its tests.
cases.expected_outcome: Route implementation and tests to spec-work instead of continuing in spec-plan.

cases.input: Plan the change and immediately patch the obvious files.
cases.expected_outcome: Research and write only the plan artifact before a blocking handoff selection; do not edit implementation source or run implementation tests.

cases.input: Fix the planning workflow by editing .agents/skills/spec-plan/SKILL.md.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the runtime mirror as generated evidence, plan the fix against skills/spec-plan source or its generator, and regenerate later through the project workflow.

cases.input: Create a deep plan; no delegation or external research authorization was provided.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not spawn research agents or access external sources; apply relevant prompt assets inline, record dispatch_authorization_missing, and complete the plan.

degraded_contract.facts: the user authorized spec-plan but did not authorize helper dispatch or external research
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: apply selected prompt assets inline or serially and complete planning
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: spawn a helper, access external sources, or reuse an old fresh-source result
degraded_contract.remaining_work: complete all locally supportable planning and review intent
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: mechanical and inline semantic judgment; no fresh-source isolation claim

cases.input: Create a deep plan with helper authorization, but the host exposes no callable subagent primitive.
cases.expected_outcome: Run the selected specialist prompts inline or serially, preserve coverage accounting, and state that context isolation was unavailable.

degraded_contract.facts: helper authorization exists but the host exposes no callable subagent capability
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: apply specialist prompts inline or serially and record degraded inherited context
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: stop planning or claim isolated parallel review
degraded_contract.remaining_work: complete planning and mandatory inline review coverage
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: inline semantic judgment without context-isolation evidence

cases.input: Plan a change when no web capability is available and one external compatibility fact may affect the recommendation.
cases.expected_outcome: Use sufficient local source when available; otherwise record the missing external fact, its decision impact, and a blocking or deferred verification instead of inventing it.

degraded_contract.facts: no callable web capability is available
degraded_contract.authorization: external research may be authorized but cannot execute
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: continue from local evidence when sufficient or surface the load-bearing evidence gap
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: fabricate current external facts or silently omit their decision impact
degraded_contract.remaining_work: verify the external fact before any decision that depends on it becomes implementation-ready
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: local-source judgment with an explicit external-evidence limitation

cases.input: Plan at unchanged HEAD after package.json or root AGENTS.md changed locally while a cache entry exists.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the cache as MISS, derive current facts, and never serve the old profile; a docs/plans-only change may retain a verified HIT.

degraded_contract.facts: a profile-input path is dirty at the current HEAD
degraded_contract.authorization: not applicable to deterministic cache freshness
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: invalidate the entry and re-derive current profile facts
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: serve the stale cached profile or treat advisory plan dirtiness as a profile input
degraded_contract.remaining_work: complete current-source grounding before planning decisions
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: deterministic cache MISS plus newly derived current facts

cases.input: Review an implementation-ready HTML plan containing actionable findings.
cases.expected_outcome: Run the structural and semantic review, keep fixes_applied at zero, return producer-fix candidates and preserve the HTML bytes.

degraded_contract.facts: the artifact is HTML and Markdown mutation mechanics are inapplicable
degraded_contract.authorization: review is authorized; reviewer mutation is not
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: return a report-only envelope and leave correction ownership with the producer
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: apply safe_auto, append Open Questions, or enter the Markdown walkthrough
degraded_contract.remaining_work: producer recompose only for uniquely determined fixes, then re-review
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: review findings and byte preservation; no reviewer autofix claim

cases.input: Run document review when one selected reviewer fails after other reviewers return valid findings.
cases.expected_outcome: Synthesize valid findings, mark the failed persona in Coverage, and avoid claiming the full roster completed.

degraded_contract.facts: at least one selected reviewer failed but valid reviewer coverage remains
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: complete synthesis from valid findings and report the missing persona
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: discard valid findings or claim complete roster coverage
degraded_contract.remaining_work: surface the uncovered lens and any resulting claim limitation
degraded_contract.claim_ceiling: partial review coverage with explicit limitations

cases.input: Run document review when coherence and feasibility both fail and no equivalent inline review completes.
cases.expected_outcome: Return review_status incomplete, keep findings/limitations visible, and suppress a clean verdict or execution handoff.

degraded_contract.facts: both always-on reviewers have zero valid results and inline fallback did not complete
degraded_contract.authorization: independent of authorization once mandatory coverage is absent
degraded_contract.expected_fallback: mark review incomplete and return coverage limitations
degraded_contract.forbidden_behavior: emit a clean verdict, claim mandatory review passed, or offer execution handoff
degraded_contract.remaining_work: obtain at least one valid mandatory reviewer or equivalent inline review

cases.input: Plan a cross-service write with MQ retry and scheduled reconciliation.
cases.expected_outcome: Make contract, idempotency, retry, ordering, final-failure/manual-recovery, observability, and verification decisions explicit or keep a launch-blocking question open.

cases.input: Plan a staged external integration behind a feature flag with a CI gate and on-call ownership.
cases.expected_outcome: Start from the on-call questions, require a production-faithful build/deploy stand-in, choose purpose-bound metrics/traces/logs with correlation and cardinality/privacy limits, name telemetry proof and alert/runbook ownership, and define the flag default, cohort, rollback trigger, and removal condition.

cases.input: Update a release-note typo without changing a build, deploy, runtime, feature flag, or operational contract.
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the plan lightweight and do not add CI fidelity, telemetry, rollout, alert, runbook, or feature-flag ceremony when no production behavior changes.

cases.input: Plan a new shared CLI result envelope consumed by three commands and a plugin adapter.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the greenfield branch, name consumers and the observable input/output/error contract, land an Interface Contracts entry with target artifact path/type/owner and creation U-ID, and assign a repo-native contract check.

cases.input: Plan removal of a deprecated response field that still has known downstream consumers.
cases.expected_outcome: Read the canonical artifact, classify the change, define replacement and consumer migration before removal, preserve a compatibility window and rollback, and require zero-use evidence plus a removal condition.

cases.input: Rename and reorganize a private helper while preserving every observable caller contract.
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the plan lightweight and do not add Interface Contracts, compatibility, deprecation, parser, or consumer-migration ceremony.

cases.input: During code review, an implementation response shape drifts from an unchanged canonical artifact and no new design decision is needed.
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the drift finding with the API contract reviewer; do not turn the reviewer into the plan-time interface design owner or create a second contract source.

cases.input: Plan a mobile account form with asynchronous submit, loading, permission denial, error, retry, and keyboard focus behavior.
cases.expected_outcome: Use the frontend lens to define component ownership, an applicable state matrix, duplicate-submit/retry behavior, semantic labels/errors, keyboard/focus restoration, responsive constraints, and runtime verification owner.

cases.input: Change CSS that removes the visible focus indicator and lowers text contrast at a mobile breakpoint.
cases.expected_outcome: Treat the behavior-visible CSS regression as a frontend trigger and plan focus, contrast, responsive verification, rather than dismissing it because no component file changed.

cases.input: Refactor a backend-only request handler without changing any user-visible route, component, response contract, or UI state.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not load frontend component/state/a11y/responsive ceremony solely because the codebase also has a web UI.

cases.input: Update a design token value that does not affect contrast, focus, layout, responsive behavior, motion, or state expression.
cases.expected_outcome: Keep the plan lightweight and do not claim a frontend engineering trigger without a user-visible contract effect.

cases.input: Plan a new skill, helper script, schema, and host runtime projection.
cases.expected_outcome: Inspect existing project-owned owners and record right-sized reuse, extend, or new decisions without treating generated runtime as source.
